class.name: WebRTCNativePeerConnection
class.description: The implementation [WebRTCPeerConnection] uses on every platform but the web, built on libdatachannel. Use [WebRTCPeerConnection] rather than this class: [code]WebRTCPeerConnection.new()[/code] creates one of these. A GDExtension that calls [method WebRTCPeerConnection.set_default_extension] replaces it. Besides the standard configuration ([code]iceServers[/code], and [code]iceTransportPolicy[/code] [code]"relay"[/code] to connect only through TURN), [method WebRTCPeerConnection.initialize] reads a [code]libdatachannel[/code] dictionary with [code]enableIceTcp[/code], [code]enableIceUdpMux[/code], [code]portRangeBegin[/code], [code]portRangeEnd[/code] and [code]mtu[/code].
